title: Révélation Y-K Design
direction: Glisser le monogramme vers la gauche sans modifier sa taille ; révéler Y-K Design à droite. Le bloc commence à monter pour préparer la galerie.
geometry_note: Les maquettes sont illustratives. Reconstruire les positions, les couleurs à plat et les typographies éditables au format 1920×1080 ; ne pas animer la planche entière.

reconstruction_details.scene_function: Reveal the name beside the monogram and prepare the gallery entrance

keyframes.state: Monogram alone at centre, name hidden
Monogram slides left; first part of Y-K Design begins to reveal
Full monogram and name form a centred compact brand lockup
Complete brand lockup begins rising together, ready for the gallery

reconstruction_details.layout_note: Measure brand text with the chosen font once; centre the entire lockup and adjust the monogram offset according to its actual width. The full lockup should occupy roughly 22–25% of frame width.
reconstruction_details.motion_note: The monogram remains the same asset. Horizontal name reveal overlaps its leftward shift. The completed lockup then rises as one group; do not replace it with an unrelated logo graphic.
reconstruction_details.next_page: Portfolio gallery of motion-design advertising examples for shops; images and claims to be chosen with the user
reconstruction_details.storyboard_note: Static illustrative board. The JSON specifies the exact render canvas and intended scale continuity; the brand rise must be reconstructed with timeline keyframes rather than inferred from generated panel geometry.
